title: Argus-C2 administrator login request
$comment: POST /api/v1/auth/login. Go validation additionally rejects duplicates, case variants, nulls, invalid Unicode, control characters, and input over 1024 bytes. Password creation requires at least 15 Unicode characters; login accepts shorter incorrect credentials without revealing account existence.

password.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters. Never log this field.
